profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at DrFirst, Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Analyze, design, develop, and maintain full stack solutions for the flagship e-prescribing web application and related products, with a preferred focus on solving complex front-end, workflow, and longstanding obscurely critical problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain web-based and desktop applications which serve as the primary enterprise content management systems for staff within the Office of Student Financial Aid, Admissions, and related offices

- Meet with users (University staff) to assess needs, application architecture, and design

- Technologies Used: J2EE, Java, JSP, JavaScript, iText PDF, XHTML, SQL, CSS, C++, GWT, YUI, jQuery, PHP, Websphere, Tomcat, SQL Developer, Adobe CS, and Optix Content Management System

Summary of owned projects:
- Implemented a web application for requests, submission, and management of undergraduate student admission recommendations. Accumulated over 20,000 users within the first 2 months of production.

- Implemented Web 2.0 UI modernization of the web applications used by student aid recipients, financial aid counselors and other campus staff for managing student financial aid offers, internal student award processing, and collecting student documents.

- Implemented a web application for campus-wide management of scholarship award thank you notes from students to award donors. Application allowed faculty and staff across campus to configure fully customizable scholarship applications to be made available to students for searching, submitting, and tracking status.

- Implemented a web application for generating unique barcodes associated with prospective students in order to simplify the transfer of admission application materials from paper to electronic form.

- Implemented major modifications to an existing C++ desktop application such that it is now able to read in student barcodes, associate a bundle of documents with the corresponding student, and transfer the bundle into the campus document repository.
positions.insights: Front-End Development, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +1 skill

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Member of a four person intern team which created a stand-alone desktop application related to Microsoft Small Business Server

- Performed the functions of program manager, software developer, and tester

- Implemented the application's UI within Microsoft Visual Studio, using C# for logic, WinForms for UI components, and XML for data serialization and storage

- Prepared and delivered presentation and demo of final product before SBS team leads, management from other departments, and multiple other intern teams

- Received accolades from superiors for exceptional presentation skills

- Received solid recommendation from direct manager for return to Microsoft within the Small Business Server team for future employment
